Professor Ajith Medis has extensive experience in academia, financial services, business strategy, and management. He joined academia in 2002 after a decade of working with LOLC, People’s Merchant Bank, and Mitsui & Company. He previously held senior positions in the financial services sector, including Chief Executive Officer of PMF Finance PLC, Director of Alliance Finance PLC, Overseas Consultant to the Indian School of Business in Hyderabad, and many others. He has also provided consultancy services to over 30 finance companies in various capacities, both local and overseas. His expertise includes implementing turnaround strategies for ailing entities, enhancing top- and bottom-line performance for growth, and restoring corporate fundamentals. 

Professor Medis holds a Bachelor of Commerce (Special Honors) degree from the University of Kelaniya, a Master of Business Administration from the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, and a PhD in Strategy from Management and Science University, Malaysia. He also holds a Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing from the Chartered Institute of Marketing in the UK and a Certified Management Accountant qualification from Australia.

His combined academic expertise, financial-sector experience, and strategic management background will contribute to the leadership and future development of SMB Finance PLC.
